crossRefs.note: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that…
He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in…
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the…
Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

translations.web: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?
translations.bsb: What business of mine is it to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?
translations.kjv: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do ➔ not ye judge them that are within?
translations.asv: For what have I to do with judging them that are without? Do not ye judge them that are within?
